verdict.rationale: Lambda supports provisioning large multi-GPU clusters (16–512 GPUs) in one action via 1-Click Clusters, and its REST API plus cloud-init lets users programmatically create/manage many instances and schedule multi-node jobs via Slurm/Kubernetes, which constitutes a form of bulk operation across compute resources. However, there is no explicit evidence of bulk API endpoints (e.g., batch create/delete/update calls) or dedicated tooling for bulk item management beyond cluster launch and job scheduling. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch API operations documentation, evidence of bulk resource management (e.g., mass instance termination, batch metadata updates), and independent confirmation of scale beyond community-built unofficial CLI/MCP tooling.
